approve.purpose: Given a payo-flows bug work item ID, automatically investigate and confirm the bug, implement and fleet-verify a fix, open and self-remediate a PR, and produce a human-reviewable summary — looping back to fix+deploy+test wherever tests, self-review, or human review surface unresolved issues.
useCases: A tester or engineer files a bug against payo-flows and wants an end-to-end automated fix without manually driving investigation, fleet deployment, e2e verification, and PR review.
Team wants consistent evidence-backed e2e verification (personal fleet + test run) attached to every payo-flows bug-fix PR.
Team wants self-review findings auto-remediated before a human ever looks at the PR.

existingChecked.name: infrastructure/set-concept
existingChecked.why: closest generic analog, but linear with no fleet-deploy/e2e/PR/self-review concepts and no native loop-back

pattern.name: Orchestrator template
pattern.why: 4 independently-evolvable multi-step phases, each with its own approval gates. Orchestrator itself contains only phase-spawning steps + the 2 framework steps.

params.name: workItemId
params.desc: ADO work item ID of the bug to fix

steps.name: Investigate and confirm bug
steps.desc: Pull work item from ADO, reproduce/analyze root cause, embed Q&A substep if understanding is incomplete. Gate confirms full understanding before fix design.

steps.name: Implement, deploy, and verify fix
steps.desc: Propose fix → implement → deploy to a personal fleet dedicated to this bug → run e2e tests with evidence. On test failure, tear down the old personal fleet, redeploy fresh, and retest.

steps.name: Open PR and remediate self-review
steps.desc: Create PR referencing the work item with test evidence linked. Run automated self-review, post findings as PR comments.

steps.name: Produce human review summary
steps.desc: Generate a full review markdown describing the behaviors/decisions actually developed in the PR. Present to human reviewer.

keyDecisions: Orchestrator pattern chosen over a single flat workflow because the process has 4 independently-evolvable multi-step phases, each needing its own approval gate.
Orchestrator parameters kept to just workItemId; sub-processes gather their own context.
Both remediation loops (self-review findings, human review change requests) target the same Implement/Deploy/Verify phase instead of duplicating fix-loop logic.

No existing reusable steps found anywhere in the installation for investigation, fix, fleet deploy, e2e test, PR, self-review, or human-review-summary — all 4 sub-process templates authored fresh as native process templates.
